title: Runnin' da Show
subtitle: Command phase, secondaries, stratagems & army rules

bullets: Every battle round starts wiv da [b]Command phase[/b]: +1 CP, den yer secondary missions.
Da mission review shows what yer scorin' for — [b]Discard[/b] one for a CP, or [b]Replace[/b] it for a CP.
Army rules live in da command panel — [b]CALL DA WAAAGH![/b] is once per battle.
[b][S] Stratagems[/b] spends CP any time it's legal; [b]Missions[/b] an' [b]Roster[/b] show scorin' an' yer army.
Dat's da lot — every phase, every button. Now go krump somefin' for real.

prompt.kbm: Da Custodes had deir go — now every round opens wiv da [b]Command phase[/b]: bank a CP, sort yer secondaries, fire off army rules. Dis card lists da missions ya can score dis round an' what each pays. Ya could [b]Replace[/b] one for 1 CP — we'll keep 'em. Click [b]Continue[/b].
prompt.pad: Every round opens wiv da [b]Command phase[/b]: a CP, yer secondaries, den army rules. Dis card lists what ya can score — {dpad} moves da highlight, {a} presses. Pick [b]Continue[/b].

done.comment: Continue clears the phase's newly-drawn list and frees the dialog; a bare node_hidden check would pass on the frame before the dialog pops

hint.text: Da same missions are listed down da right panel too, wiv [b]Discard (+1 CP)[/b] buttons.

prompt.kbm: Some missions ask ya to make a choice da moment dey're drawn. Dis one wants a guard on each objective. Ya can pick 'em yerself — or take da game's suggestion wiv [b]Keep Auto Picks[/b].
prompt.pad: Some missions want a choice when dey're drawn — dis one wants guards on objectives. {dpad} to [b]Keep Auto Picks[/b], den {a} to take da game's suggestion.

done.comment: gate on the mission's own pending_interaction flag as well as the dialog node: the dialog is spawned a frame or two after this step arms, so a bare node-gone check would pass instantly

hint.text: [b]Pick on board[/b] next to a row lets ya click da unit on da table instead of usin' da dropdown.

prompt.kbm: Army rules sit in da command panel. Da Orks get one big 'un: hit [b]CALL DA WAAAGH![/b] — once per battle, every Ork can Advance an' still charge, hits harder in melee an' gets a 5+ invuln.
prompt.pad: Army rules sit in da command panel. {dpad} ▼ hops in, ▼ again lands on [b]CALL DA WAAAGH![/b] — {a} calls it. Once per battle, an' every Ork gets meaner.

hint.text: Every faction's got its own section here — dis is where army rules get fired off.

prompt.kbm: CP buys [b]stratagems[/b]. Open da panel wiv [b][S] Stratagems[/b] at da bottom — it lists what ya can use right now, what it costs, an' greys out da rest wiv da reason why. Have a look, den hit [b]Close[/b].
prompt.pad: CP buys [b]stratagems[/b]. Da bottom bar ain't on da {dpad} route, so glide {ls} onto [b]Stratagems[/b] an' press {a} — da panel lists what ya can use now an' greys out da rest wiv da reason why. Have a look, den [b]Close[/b].

hint.text: Da panel greys out anyfin' ya can't afford or can't use in dis phase.

prompt.kbm: Dat's da Command phase. [b]End Command Phase[/b] moves ya on to Movement — an' round two runs Movement, Shootin', Charge, Fight, Scorin', same as round one.
prompt.pad: Press {menu} to end da Command phase an' move on to Movement.

prompt.text: Dat's every phase an' every button: musterin', movin', shootin', chargin', krumpin' an' runnin' da show. Da rest is just playin'. [b]WAAAGH![/b]
